lcc_original: 上帝說：『天下的水要積聚在一處，讓旱地露出來。』就這樣成了。
notes: 神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC) for H0430; both render אֱלֹהִים (Elohim)
聚 (UNV) → 積聚 (LCC) for H6960 קָוָה; LCC uses a two-character compound — SN tags attached to 積聚 as a unit
使 (UNV) → 讓 (LCC) — both are causative particles with no SN annotation in UNV; left unannotated in LCC
UNV has 事 before 就這樣 (unannotated, added for readability); LCC omits it entirely — WAH03651 attaches directly to 就這樣
LCC uses 『』 vs UNV 「」 — quotation marks preserved as-is per rule 7
